FUND OVERVIEW The Fund seeks to track the performance of an index composed of the 600 largest companies from European developed countries. KEY RISKS: The value of equities and equity-related securities can be affected by daily stock market movements. Other influential factors include political, economic news, company earnings and significant corporate events. Counterparty Risk: The insolvency of any institutions providing services such as safekeeping of assets or acting as counterparty to derivatives or other instruments, may expose the Fund to financial loss.
